---
title: "Chat Demo: Copy, Paste, Run"
---

This notebook is for the copy-and-paste demo. Run the chunk below, then copy the **code** into a chatbot and ask:

> Can you help me visualize this?

Paste the reply into a new chunk and run it.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

estimates <- read_csv(here::here("inputs/raw/subgroup_estimates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

estimates <- estimates |>
  mutate(estimate_percent = parse_number(Estimate, na = c("NA", "--", "Suppressed", "not available")))

estimates |>
  group_by(Measure) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_percent = mean(estimate_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## What to notice

- The chatbot saw only the code you pasted. It didn't see the data, the codebook, or the output.
- You carried all of the context back and forth by hand.
- If it plotted by `Subgroup Category`, did it notice that one category is spelled three ways ("Adequacy of Prenatal care", "Adequacy of Prenatal Care", "Adequacy prenatal care")? It had no way to know.
